title: Data Science
description: Learn to frame data questions, inspect and clean datasets, run reproducible analyses, and communicate evidence responsibly.

paths.title: Data Foundations
paths.description: Understand data questions, datasets, cleaning, and exploratory analysis.

paths.title: A Practical Analysis Workflow
paths.description: Move from a question to a reproducible analysis and clear conclusion.

paths.title: Communicate with Data
paths.description: Choose honest visualizations and explain uncertainty.

cards.title: What data science does
cards.prompt: Data science uses data, code, statistics, and domain knowledge to answer questions and support decisions.
cards.content: The work includes defining a useful question, collecting appropriate data, cleaning it, analyzing patterns, building models when needed, and communicating limitations.

cards.title: Rows are observations; columns are variables
cards.prompt: A rectangular dataset usually represents one observation per row and one measured characteristic per column.
cards.content: A clear unit of observation prevents accidental duplication and makes joins, summaries, and models easier to reason about.

cards.title: Identify the unit of observation
cards.prompt: A table has one row for every purchase. What is the unit of observation?

question.explanation: Each row represents one purchase, even if the same customer appears many times.

cards.title: Inspect a new dataset
cards.prompt: Before analysis, learn what the dataset can and cannot represent.
cards.content: Early inspection catches missing columns, unexpected units, duplicate records, invalid categories, and date parsing problems.
items: Read the source and collection method.
Check column names and data types.
Look for duplicates and impossible values.
Confirm units, date ranges, and category meanings.

cards.title: Turn a question into an analysis plan
cards.prompt: A strong analysis begins with a specific decision or claim rather than a chart.
cards.content: Write the plan before exploring results so the analysis is less likely to chase accidental patterns.
steps: Identify likely bias and missing data.
Define what result would change the decision.

cards.title: Summarize a dataset with pandas
cards.prompt: A compact summary reveals shape, data types, missingness, and basic distributions.
cards.content: Use these outputs as diagnostics, not as automatic proof that the data is valid.

code.snippet:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv("survey.csv")
print(df.shape)
print(df.dtypes)
print(df.isna().sum())
print(df.describe(include="all"))

cards.title: Cleaning decisions are analytical decisions
cards.prompt: Replacing, deleting, or correcting values changes the evidence used by the analysis.
cards.content: Document each transformation and preserve raw data. A reproducible pipeline should produce the cleaned dataset from the original source.

cards.title: Avoid leakage
cards.prompt: A model predicts whether a loan will default. Which feature is data leakage?

options: Default collection status recorded after the loan ended
question.explanation: Information recorded after the outcome would not be available when making the prediction.

cards.title: A chart must match the question
cards.prompt: Different charts reveal different relationships: distributions, comparisons, change over time, or association.
cards.content: Choose the simplest visual that exposes the relevant comparison. Decorative complexity can hide scale, uncertainty, or missing groups.

cards.title: Choose a distribution chart
cards.prompt: Which chart is most suitable for showing the distribution of one continuous variable?

question.explanation: A histogram groups numeric values into intervals and shows how frequently values occur.

cards.title: Correlation does not establish causation
cards.prompt: Two variables can move together because of confounding, reverse causation, selection effects, or coincidence.
cards.content: Causal claims need a defensible design, such as randomization or carefully justified observational methods, not only a high correlation.

cards.title: Publish a trustworthy analysis
cards.prompt: A useful analysis makes its assumptions and limitations visible.
cards.content: Readers should be able to understand where the data came from, reproduce the major steps, and distinguish evidence from interpretation.
items: Describe the data source and exclusions.
Use labeled charts with honest scales.
Provide code or a reproducible notebook.
